d.t: A traditional Chinese unit of length, 10 Chinese feet or ¹/₁₅₀ Chinese mile.
Synonym of congee, a thick rice porridge.
d.e: We did, however, send them to a Chinese nursery school that fed them a daily lunch of zhou, a rice porridge with various seasonings: pickled turnips, flakes of dough sticks, green or red beans, sesame paste, or something called hot prickly mustard tubers.

d.t: An ancient Chinese unit of weight, notionally equivalent to 100 millet seeds or 1/24 of the liang/tael/Chinese ounce, chiefly used in denominating small coins in ancient and early imperial China.

d.t: An ancient Chinese string instrument thought to have had a rectangular zither-like body with silk strings played with a bow.
A member of an ethnic group living mostly in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in southern China.
d.e: During the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution over 200 teeth of the giant ape were found in Chienshih County, Hupeh Province, and Pama County, the Kwangsi Chuang Autonomous Region.
